subagent_roles.responsibility: Rust/WASM runtime architecture in native/world-host: WebGPU+WebGL2 capability tiering, remote content-addressed web asset resolver, incremental add/drop GPU eviction, and hierarchical World-to-Cosmos OCS floating-origin frames.
Deterministic Synth CLI multi-LOD (.10d) & mobile texture compilation for all 13 eco-intent species, above-ground vs subterranean root/mycelium split, and .q42 species catalog generation.
Upgraded 600m x 600m SE Australian catchment terrain (.10d/.m64), PBR soil/rock/water shaders, upgraded campsite/bridge/station assets, and 4-bioregion regional DEM tile packs.

Terrain-conforming walk/fly/observe locomotion, mobile touch joysticks, ecological placement of all 13 species, fauna behavioral loops + spatial .qac audio, rhizosphere/mycelium X-ray lens, and Q42 SPARQL species inspection cards.
Independent build, unit test, and 3-profile browser verification (Desktop WebGPU, Desktop WebGL2 forced, Mobile WebGL2 touch emulation) plus HTML no-GPU fallback audit and screenshot review.

packets.title: WebGPU + WebGL2 Capability Tiering & Backend Parity
deliverables: Automatic GPU capability probing assigning TierA (Desktop WebGPU), TierB (Desktop WebGL2 / Mobile WebGPU), and TierC (Mobile WebGL2)
Query flag ?backend=webgl2 for deterministic WebGL2 fallback testing on desktop
Tier-aware triangle, texture resolution, shadow map, and DPR caps published to window.__webizenNativeInit
Unit tests verifying tier selection and safe fallback to /publication/reading.html when neither API is available
packets.acceptance: Both WebGPU and forced WebGL2 initialize cleanly with honest selected_backend telemetry and zero unhandled shader/buffer errors.

packets.title: 13-Species intenteco Multi-LOD & Mobile Pack Pipeline
deliverables: Deterministic Python + Synth CLI pipeline generating LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 .10d assets inside each species repo (C:\github\eco-intent\<species-slug>\dist\lods\) without duplicating binaries into webizen-website Git history
Split above-ground vs subterranean root+mycelium .10d layers for the 7 flora species so rhizosphere X-ray toggles cleanly

Lightweight data/ewm/species-catalog.ttl & data/ewm/species-catalog.q42 committed to webizen-website with did:q42 taxon IRIs, pinned intenteco repo/ref, SHA-256 digests, AABBs, and logical /intenteco/<slug>/... + remote raw.githubusercontent.com/intenteco/... URLs
Local dev mount in tooling/world_server.py mapping /intenteco/<species-slug>/ directly to C:\github\eco-intent\<species-slug>\ for zero-copy local testing
packets.acceptance: All 13 species compile to verified LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 .10d packages within TierA/B/C triangle and byte budgets and query cleanly via SPARQL.

packets.title: Upgraded 600m Catchment Terrain, Water & Regional Bioregion Tiles
deliverables: High-detail 600m x 600m SE Australian river catchment heightfield (.10d + .m64) with floodplain, creek banks, pebble bars, and sandstone/granite ridges
Multi-material PBR terrain splatting (alluvial silt, mossy bank, leaf litter, rocky outcrop) compatible with WebGPU and WebGL2
Upgraded campsite, footbridge, and field station assets re-anchored to the new heightfield
4-bioregion regional DEM tile pack (Northern Rivers, Sydney Basin, Snowy Mountains, Victorian Highlands) via native/data-pack-builder
packets.acceptance: Terrain renders without winding/seam artifacts on WebGPU and WebGL2, with deterministic heightAt(x, z) parity between VibeScript and rendered mesh.

packets.title: Content-Addressed Web Asset Resolver & OPFS/Cache Layer
deliverables: Multi-source content-addressed URL resolver supporting: (1) zero-CORS same-origin static/GitHub-Pages paths (/production/, /packages/), (2) CORS-enabled remote mirrors (raw.githubusercontent.com/intenteco/* and future Cloudflare R2/Webizen Host CORS+Range endpoints, explicitly avoiding non-CORS github.com/releases redirects), and (3) digest-addressed mirror fallback
Mandatory SHA-256/SHA-384 + binary magic (.10d/.q42/.emf/.m64/.qac) admission gate and NetworkDisclosureRegistry logging
Browser Cache API / OPFS local persistence layer with graceful fallback in private browsing
EWM streaming enabled by default (with ?ewm=0 fallback)
packets.acceptance: Remote and local catalog assets fetch, verify cryptographically, cache locally, and reject tampered hashes or non-allowlisted origins.

packets.title: Dynamic Scene Add/Drop, LOD Switching & Incremental GPU Eviction
deliverables: Incremental GPU add/drop scene-part eviction replacing full omit-and-rebuild stalls
Tier-bounded LRU GPU memory manager (TierA 384 MiB, TierB 192 MiB, TierC 96 MiB)
Camera-distance + frustum hysteresis LOD switching (LOD2 <-> LOD1 <-> LOD0) and in-flight fetch cancellation on rapid travel
InstanceState64 seed-driven GPU instancing for diverse woodland stands from shared species prototypes
packets.acceptance: Moving across tiles and switching places dynamically adds entering assets, drops exiting assets, and keeps GPU memory flat without frame stalls.

packets.title: Hierarchical World-to-Cosmos OCS Frame Tree & Floating Origin
deliverables: Generalized OCS Frame Tree supporting Local ENU -> Planetary WGS84/ECEF -> Heliocentric ICRF -> Extensible Cosmos frames
f64 world-space camera and object coordinates with camera-relative f32 floating-origin rebasing
Earth planetary globe handoff + JPL Horizons Earth/Moon/Mars orbital ephemeris integration (data/ewm/cosmos-catalog.q42)
Unit tests verifying continuous frame transforms without f32 jitter across 10 orders of magnitude
packets.acceptance: Smooth camera scale transition from 1m leaf inspection to 600m catchment to Earth globe to Solar System orbit with zero jitter.

packets.title: Playable Locomotion, Ground Physics & Mobile Touch Controls
deliverables: Three movement modes: Walk/Explore (terrain-conforming height + slope/water clamping), Fly/Glide (catchment-to-orbit), and Observe/Orbit
Desktop controls (WASD/Arrows, mouse look, Shift sprint, Space jump/ascend, E interact) and mobile touch controls (virtual thumbstick, drag-look, tap-to-walk/inspect)
Full keyboard-only accessibility and prefers-reduced-motion compliance
packets.acceptance: Visitors can smoothly walk the entire catchment, climb ridges, wade creeks, fly into orbit, and interact via desktop or mobile touch.

packets.title: Living Biosphere Ecology, Fauna Behaviors, Spatial Audio & Rhizosphere Lens
deliverables: Ecologically zoned placement of all 13 SE Australian species across the 600m catchment
Deterministic fauna behavioral state machines (grazing/alert/foraging/perching) + WebAudio spatial playback of species .qac vocalizations
Rhizosphere & Mycelium X-Ray Lens toggling subterranean ground transparency to display 5-order root plates, 3D mycelial cords, and .emf bio-electric fields
Click-to-inspect Q42 SPARQL Species Cards showing taxonomy, Country provenance, InstanceState64 state, and direct .hmc/.q42 downloads
packets.acceptance: All 13 species inhabit their authentic ecological niches, fauna animate and vocalize on opt-in audio, and the Rhizosphere Lens cleanly reveals subterranean root+mycelium networks.

packets.title: Dual-Backend (WebGPU + WebGL2 + Mobile) Visual & Streaming QA Gate
deliverables: Full Rust/WASM build and cargo test pass across native/world-host
Automated Chromium verification across 3 profiles: Desktop WebGPU (TierA), Desktop WebGL2 forced (?backend=webgl2, TierB), and Mobile WebGL2 touch emulation (TierC)
Visual screenshot inspection of catchment, species closeups, Rhizosphere X-Ray Lens, dynamic add/drop streaming telemetry, and Earth-to-Orbit transition
Verification of /publication/reading.html no-GPU fallback and formal PASS/REJECT gate report
packets.acceptance: All 3 GPU profiles + HTML fallback pass visual, performance, memory-eviction, and cryptographic integrity gates.

packets.title: Live GPU Scene Activation — 600m Catchment + 13-Species Streaming Loop
deliverables: Wire se-australia-catchment.q42 (317 instances) and species-catalog.q42 into the active boot + streaming GPU upload loop so all 13 intenteco species render live from /intenteco/<slug>/dist/lods/ (or remote raw.githubusercontent.com/intenteco/*) under TierA/B/C budgets
Activate catchment-600m-lod0.10d / lod1.10d + catchment-600m-water.10d + 1024px PBR maps in the live first-paint scene

Connect live Observe/Walk/Fly buttons, mobile touch thumbstick, Rhizosphere X-Ray root+mycelium layer toggle, OcsFrameTree floating-origin cosmos zoom, and click-to-inspect Species Cards + opt-in .qac audio into the active frame loop
Non-intrusive progressive streaming HUD badge showing active tier, backend, and loaded species count
packets.acceptance: Live / boots with the 600m catchment and streams all 13 SE Australian species in real time, with working Walk/Fly/Rhizosphere/Inspect interactions.

packets.title: qualia-core-db Forced WebGL2 Backend Switch & Host x86_64 Test Fix

packets.acceptance: ?backend=webgl2 reports selected_backend === "webgl2" on desktop Chrome, and cargo test --lib passes all native/world-host unit tests on Windows x86_64.

packets.title: Atmospheric, Tour, Field-Guide & Soundscape Polish
deliverables: Guided Ecological Tour teleport pills (Campsite Clearing, River Red Gum & Platypus Creek, Mountain Ash Canopy, Rhizosphere X-Ray, Kangaroo Meadow, Earth & Solar Orbit)
Interactive Species Field Guide drawer with 'Discovered X / 13 species' tracker and direct .hmc/.q42 provenance links
SE Australian Time-of-Day lighting control (Dawn / Midday / Golden Hour / Dusk + starfield fade at orbital altitude)
Opt-in Sound pill mixing ambient creek/canopy soundscape with spatialized .qac fauna vocalizations (disabled cleanly when muted or prefers-reduced-motion)
packets.acceptance: Visitors can jump to any ecological highlight in one click, track discovered species, adjust lighting, and toggle opt-in spatial bush audio on desktop and mobile.

packets.title: Final Live-World Dual-Backend (True WebGPU + True WebGL2 + Mobile) Visual Gate

Live browser verification proving true selected_backend === "webgpu" (TierA) AND true selected_backend === "webgl2" (TierB & TierC mobile) with 0 console errors
Visual screenshot inspection of live 600m catchment, 13-species woodland & fauna, Rhizosphere X-Ray root+mycelium view, Species Field Guide card, and Earth-to-Orbit transition
Final PASS gate report at plans/ewm-v2/gate-reports/wave6-live-world-gate.md
packets.acceptance: All 4 profiles pass with true WebGPU and true WebGL2 backends, zero console errors, and visually verified live 13-species catchment + cosmos scenes.

packets.title: Live Forest Replacement, Local terrain-v2 Serving & Ledger Refresh
deliverables: Replace legacy generic white-trunk trees (lush-near/lush-mid) in the active GPU scene with the live streamed 13 intenteco species (.10d LODs from /intenteco/<slug>/dist/lods/)

Expose production/terrain-v2/*.10d cleanly from world_server.py and verify local-first resolution so window.__webizenEwmState reaches streaming_phase === "active" with catchment_terrain_active === true and streamed_species_count > 0 offline (0 DNS errors)
Refresh the 2 stale pre-Wave-5 WASM SHA-256/byte assertions in legacy EWM qualification ledgers so tests/ewm/run.py passes 72/72
packets.acceptance: Live / replaces legacy trees with the 13 intenteco species, streams the 600m catchment cleanly with 0 network/console errors, and tests/ewm/run.py passes 72/72.

packets.title: NSW/EcoPunk Dataset-Driven Multi-Tile World, Slope-Conforming Roots & Community Grounds Corridor
deliverables: Download real bounded public GIS & botanical dataset slices for the SE Australian Forest-to-Town corridor (NSW Spatial Services FSDF REST roads/hydro/elevation, NSW SEED/SVTM Plant Community Types, Atlas of Living Australia species occurrences for our 17 taxa, plus any existing local ecopunk geospatial datasets), record raw source receipts (URL, SHA-256, custodian, licence, CRS/datum), and compile them into sealed local .q42 vaults (data/ewm/datasets/nsw-ecopunk-sources.q42 & data/ewm/datasets/corridor-gis-botany.q42) verifiable via query_sparql

Replace single-tile streaming with a continuous 3x3 geospatial tile grid (gis_join.rs) that dynamically loads entering tiles, queries per-tile bioregion/PCT/soil/slope/hydrology datasets to deterministically generate location-appropriate flora/fauna/groundcover placements, and evicts departing tiles via GpuResidencyLedger LRU

Connect Forest Campsite tiles -> winding dirt forestry track & rural bitumen road corridor -> open Town-Outskirts Community Grounds tiles (cleared paddock/oval perimeter, gravel access loop, shelter/pavilion pad, fencing) ready for driving with the camper

Implement slope-conforming subterranean root-plate alignment & soil-line burial (sampling terrain heightAt + surface normal / downhill gradient) so 5-order flora roots and mycorrhizal plates stay strictly below the soil line on hillsides
packets.acceptance: Moving across tiles dynamically generates and streams dataset-driven bioregion assets, transitions cleanly from Forest Campsite to Town-Outskirts Community Grounds, and keeps all flora root plates buried below sloped soil lines.

packets.title: Native Long Grasses, Tussocks & Understorey Shrubs Cohort
deliverables: Produce lightweight, wind-swaying multi-LOD .10d groundcover & shrub packs (LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 + slope-safe root tuft) via Synth CLI in anti-monolith eco-intent repos: Poa labillardierei (long river/snow tussock grass), Themeda triandra (Kangaroo Grass), Lomandra longifolia (Spiny-headed Mat-rush), and Bursaria spinosa (Sweet Bursaria native shrub)
Register all 4 groundcover/shrub taxa in data/ewm/species-catalog.ttl & .q42 (expanding the catalog from 13 to 17 taxa) for dense instanced forest understorey and town-outskirts meadow coverage
packets.acceptance: All 4 native grass/shrub packs verify cleanly via Synth CLI previews and SPARQL, within TierA/B/C mobile WebGL2 triangle budgets.

packets.title: Human Anatomy System — Ontology, Biomechanics & .q42 Knowledge Vault
deliverables: Anti-monolith Homo sapiens anatomy repository under C:\github\eco-intent\homo-sapiens\ with FMA/UBERON-aligned IRIs, osteology kinematic chains (28-joint SKL2 rig), myology muscle groups, cardiopulmonary/neural organs, joint ROM limits, and anthropometric ratios
Sealed data/ewm/human-anatomy.q42 queryable via SPARQL for anatomy inspection cards and character rig constraints
packets.acceptance: human-anatomy.q42 compiles cleanly, passes query_sparql checks, and provides complete biomechanical parameters for WEB-WP-17 and WEB-WP-18.

packets.title: Human Anatomy System — Layered CAD (Osteology/Myology/Integument), SKL2 Rig & .emf Field
deliverables: Multi-layer articulated human anatomy produced via Synth CLI (production16): Layer 1 Osteology (cranium, spine, ribcage, pelvis, articulated limbs), Layer 2 Myology & Major Organs (heart, lungs, major muscle groups), Layer 3 Clothed Explorer Integument
28-joint SKL2 skeletal rig + multi-LOD .10d exports (LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 + anatomy-xray.10d) + cardiac/neural bio-electric .emf volume, verified with deterministic --reopen and visual preview inspection
packets.acceptance: Bit-exact --reopen verified .hmc + multi-LOD .10d + .emf assets under C:\github\eco-intent\homo-sapiens\dist\ within TierA/B/C budgets, visually reviewed via front/side/3/4 previews.

packets.title: Playable Human Character, Foot-IK/NLA Locomotion & 1st/3rd-Person Camera
deliverables: Instantiate the playable Webizen Explorer character from homo-sapiens LOD0/LOD1/LOD2 + SKL2 rig in the live world
Procedural + NLA/two-bone foot-IK locomotion states: idle breathing, terrain-conforming walk/jog/sprint, slope lean, jump/land, inspect reach, and seated driver pose
Seamless 1st-person <-> 3rd-person camera toggle (V) and toggleable Anatomical X-Ray layer (showing osteology/myology/cardiac .emf)
packets.acceptance: Character walks smoothly over the 600m terrain with grounded foot placement, transitions between 1st/3rd-person views, and seats cleanly inside the Passat.

packets.title: Drivable VW Passat B7 + Articulated Jayco Camper Towing Dynamics & Forest-to-Community-Grounds Drive
deliverables: 4-wheel spring-damper suspension sampling terrain heightAt(x, z) at FL/FR/RL/RR contact patches with realistic body pitch, roll, and bush-track articulation

Slip-angle tyre friction model with surface-dependent grip (gravel track, bitumen road, grass clearing, alluvial silt, creek bank), Ackermann steering, rotating/steering wheel sub-parts, automatic/manual gear curve, handbrake (Space), and headlights/brake lights

Articulated tow-hitch & 2-wheel Jayco wind-up camper trailer dynamics (hitch/unhitch toggle, ball-hitch pivot constraint, trailer yaw/jackknife damping, ground-conforming trailer axle) supporting the full drive from Forest Campsite to Town-Outskirts Community Grounds
Enter/Exit vehicle interaction (F / Drive button) switching between character locomotion and seated driving with chase + bonnet/cockpit cameras and tree/campsite/fence collision clamping
Comprehensive pure-Rust unit tests for suspension equilibrium, steering radius, braking distance, slope traction, trailer hitch articulation, and collision response
packets.acceptance: Player can hitch the Jayco camper to the gold VW Passat, drive smoothly from the Forest Campsite along the road corridor to the Town-Outskirts Community Grounds with realistic vehicle + trailer dynamics, and unhitch/exit cleanly.

packets.title: Unified Playable HUD — Mode Strip, Vehicle Cluster, Compass/Scale & Drawer Manager
deliverables: Cohesive HUD layout with mutual-exclusion drawer manager (opening Field Guide auto-collapses Explore Places so panels never overlap) and collapsible clean-view toggle (H)
Context-sensitive mode strip (Observe | Walk | Drive | Fly | 1st/3rd Person | Anatomy/Rhizosphere X-Ray) + live heading compass & OCS altitude/scale readout

Contextual Vehicle Instrument Cluster (visible only in Drive mode): km/h speedometer, gear (P/R/N/D), pitch/roll inclinometer, traction indicator, headlights (L), Exit (F), plus mobile touch steering & pedal controls (>= 44x44 px)
packets.acceptance: Zero overlapping UI panels on desktop or mobile, responsive vehicle instruments in Drive mode, and full keyboard + mobile touch accessibility.

Visual screenshot inspection of: live streamed 600m catchment + 13 species, human anatomy + Explorer character, driving the Passat with active Vehicle HUD, and clean non-overlapping Unified HUD
